articles.title: A stolen iPhone, $14,000 in losses and London's crypto theft problem
articles.snippet: Two strangers befriended Magnus Ahmad outside a London bar. Hours later, thieves had emptied his crypto wallets, accessed his bank accounts and disabled his laptop.

articles.title: Traders are already placing leveraged bets on Anthropic’s IPO using crypto contracts
articles.snippet: Trade.xyz’s new ANT contract fell about 20% in its first hour on Hyperliquid. There are no shares behind it, and U.S. traders are locked out.

articles.title: Bitcoin stolen from Binance tops Tesla’s holdings and is over twice El Salvador’s reserve
articles.snippet: The 18,270 BTC haul is worth about $1.4 billion and comes within 442 coins of SpaceX’s disclosed holdings. Blockchain investigators link the attack to North Korea.

articles.title: OpenAI reportedly cuts fundraising and valuation targets amid AI jitters
articles.snippet: Anxiety about the AI boom has sent the Nasdaq 100 slumping by about 10% in just three weeks since hitting a record high on October 6, including a 4.5% drop on Friday.

articles.title: Strategy CFO Andrew Kang resigns as company posts record operating profit
articles.snippet: Andrew Kang’s departure comes as Strategy reports $21 billion in quarterly operating income and bitcoin holdings of 848,517 BTC.
